nodes.label: Push API
nodes.desc: Registers the distributor push endpoints and wraps them with authentication and per-tenant limits.

nodes.label: Push Capture
nodes.desc: Wraps the external push service so the profile-dump recorder can sample incoming profiles for debugging.

nodes.label: Distributor
nodes.desc: Parses every pushed sample, enforces ingestion rate limits, and hands each series to the write-path router.

nodes.label: pprof Parser
nodes.desc: Decompresses and parses raw pprof protobuf payloads with a hard cap on decompressed size.

nodes.label: Write Path Router
nodes.desc: Routes each series to the segment-writer path, the legacy ingester path, or both, honoring tenant overrides.

nodes.label: Writer Shard
nodes.desc: Ordered write shards keyed by tenant and service so each segment has a single writer goroutine.

nodes.label: In-Memory Head
nodes.desc: In-memory head that ingests samples per dataset until the owning segment is flushed.

nodes.label: Segment Flush
nodes.desc: Flushes dataset heads into one block file, uploads it to the bucket, and stores its metadata.

nodes.label: Dataset Index Writer
nodes.desc: Builds the per-tenant dataset index embedded in each flushed segment block.

nodes.label: Index Raft Handler
nodes.desc: Raft command handler that applies block metadata to the replicated metastore index.

nodes.label: Object Storage
nodes.desc: Bucket interface that every write and read of block data goes through.

nodes.label: Bucket Client Factory
nodes.desc: Creates bucket clients for S3, GCS, Azure, Swift and filesystem-backed storage.

nodes.label: Metastore Index Service
nodes.desc: Registers new blocks and serves block metadata listings to writers and readers.

nodes.label: Multitenant Compactor
nodes.desc: Ring-sharded compactor that plans compaction work per tenant and manages ownership.

nodes.label: Compaction Worker
nodes.desc: Claims compaction jobs and merges low-compaction-level blocks into larger ones.

nodes.label: Compaction Service
nodes.desc: Coordinates compaction job assignment and completion through the metastore.

nodes.label: Ingester (v1)
nodes.desc: Legacy ingester that routes pushes to per-tenant instances behind a ring.

nodes.label: Tenant Instance
nodes.desc: Per-tenant instance that wraps a local PhlareDB database with a prefixed bucket.

nodes.label: PhlareDB
nodes.desc: Local block store that ingests into a head and periodically flushes parquet-based blocks.

nodes.label: PhlareDB Head
nodes.desc: In-memory head holding recent profiles per tenant before block flush.

nodes.label: Block Shipper
nodes.desc: Uploads flushed local blocks to the shared object-storage bucket.

nodes.label: Read Path Router
nodes.desc: Splits query ranges between the legacy frontend and the v2 query frontend.

nodes.label: Query Frontend
nodes.desc: Fetches block metadata, builds a query plan, and invokes query backends with retry and pushback.

nodes.label: Query Plan Builder
nodes.desc: Builds balanced MERGE/READ trees over block metadata to bound merges per query.

nodes.label: Query Backend
nodes.desc: Executes query-plan nodes, merging child results and collecting execution diagnostics.

nodes.label: Block Reader
nodes.desc: READ-node executor that fetches only the datasets a query needs from object storage.

nodes.label: Querier (legacy)
nodes.desc: Plans queries across ingesters and store-gateways and merges the returned series.

nodes.label: Ingester Client Pool
nodes.desc: Ring-backed pool of bidi streaming clients used to query ingester replicas.

nodes.label: Store Gateway
nodes.desc: Shuffles block ownership across a ring and serves metadata and queries for its blocks.

nodes.label: Bucket Store
nodes.desc: Answers block-metadata requests and streams series from blocks assigned to this gateway.

nodes.label: Block Querier
nodes.desc: Opens a single block and resolves parquet dataset tables and symbol tables for queries.
